title: Read the footnotes before repeating the headline
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Find the original claim — Trace the headline to its source.; Read the denominator — Identify population, units, and baseline.; Check the conditions — Keep exclusions, dates, and versions attached.; Separate interpretation — Distinguish the result from your inference.; Choose a bounded use — Apply the evidence at the strength it supports..
